statement: The Gaussian propeller conjecture in every dimension. Proves that the sum of squared Gaussian first moments of any finite measurable partition is at most $`9/(8\pi)`$. In dimension at least two, three planar sectors of angle $`2\pi/3`$, extended orthogonally, attain the bound. Combined with the separate Unique Games theorem, this proves NP-hardness of improving the loss factor $`(8\pi/9)(1-1/k)`$ for identity-target kernel clustering with fixed k ≥ 3 on rational centered positive semidefinite inputs.
